about_short_description.short_description: Gently is a personal care brand that emphasizes efficacy and gentle formulas with natural ingredients and free from harmful chemicals.

product.name: GENTLY Baby Rash Cream 20gr
product.description: A cream formulated with Zinc Oxide and natural antimicrobials to prevent and treat diaper rash in babies and toddlers.

product.name: GENTLY Calming Baby Cream 20gr
product.description: A cream with peppermint, lavender, and aloe vera to soothe and moisturize baby skin and promote relaxation and better sleep.

product.name: GENTLY Candlenut Shampoo 100ml
product.description: A shampoo containing candlenut oil, vitamin E, and beetroot extract to clean, nourish, and soften hair and scalp for babies and children.

product.name: GENTLY Baby Face Cream
product.description: A cream designed to moisturize and protect the delicate facial skin of babies.

product.name: GENTLY Baby Gentle Cologne
product.description: A mild cologne formulated for babies to provide a gentle fragrance without harsh chemicals.

product.name: GENTLY Baby Hair Serum 60ml
product.description: A hair serum to nourish and smooth baby hair, making it easier to manage and style.
